import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with size by weight
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
                     s=data['weight_grams']/2, alpha=0.6, 
                     c=data['model_year'], cmap='viridis')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(size=weight, color=year)', fontsize=11)
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Year')

# 2. Brand distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
brand_counts = data['brand'].value_counts()
ax2.bar(brand_counts.index, brand_counts.values, color='steelblue', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Camera Count by Brand', fontsize=11)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Sensor type distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sensor_counts = data['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%',
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11)

# 4. Price by brand
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
brands = data['brand'].unique()
for brand in brands:
    brand_data = data[data['brand'] == brand]
    ax4.scatter([brand] * len(brand_data), brand_data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=100, label=brand)
ax4.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Price Distribution by Brand', fontsize=11)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Weight vs Year
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.scatter(data['model_year'], data['weight_grams'], 
           c=data['price_usd'], cmap='coolwarm', s=150, alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Weight vs Year (color=price)', fontsize=11)

# 6. Body type distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_counts = data['body_type'].value_counts()
ax6.barh(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color='coral', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11)

# 7. 4K Video capability
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
video_4k = data['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
ax7.bar(labels, [video_4k.get(0, 0), video_4k.get(1, 0)], 
        color=['lightcoral', 'lightgreen'], alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11)

# 8. Max ISO comparison
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax8.barh(data['brand'] + ' ' + data['model_year'].astype(str), 
         data['max_iso'], color='purple', alpha=0.6)
ax8.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Max ISO by Camera', fontsize=11)
ax8.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=8)

# 9. Summary statistics table
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_stats = pd.DataFrame({
    'Metric': ['Avg Price', 'Avg MP', 'Avg Weight', 'Avg Year'],
    'Value': [f'${data["price_usd"].mean():.0f}',
              f'{data["megapixels"].mean():.1f}',
              f'{data["weight_grams"].mean():.0f}g',
              f'{data["model_year"].mean():.0f}']
})
table = ax9.table(cellText=summary_stats.values, colLabels=summary_stats.columns,
                  cellLoc='center', loc='center', bbox=[0, 0.3, 1, 0.6])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(10)
table.scale(1, 2)
ax9.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=11, pad=20)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
